categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/netaddress.cpp, src/netaddress.h, and src/addrman.cpp with the P2P label, modifying network address key serialization used for address relay.
categories.rationale: Prevents cross-network address key collisions in per-peer bloom filters that could incorrectly suppress address relay between Tor and I2P addresses. The PR description notes that 'it would be possible for two I2P and Tor addresses to have the same output from CService::GetKey()', though actual random collisions are cryptographic edge cases, making this a worthwhile correctness fix rather than a release-critical issue.
